original_acceptance: Every metric has input revisions, method/configuration, denominators and measured/not-run state.
The contribution claim is limited to measured supported asset scenarios, including negative results.
No world-first or universal superiority claim follows from adding inventory, deduplication or scheduling.
Every listed artifact exists or has an agreed equivalent path, and an independent reviewer can reproduce the documented procedure.

asset_research_plan.decision: Build a reproducible asset-only benchmark testing identity, change fidelity, evidence quality and bounded recollection, including whether their combined workflow earns a measurable benefit.
questions: Which independently reviewed asset facts and change sequences exercise false merges, missed changes, stale evidence and partial collection?
Does adaptive recollection resolve comparable evidence gaps with less collection cost than full refresh under identical safety limits?
Which claimed gain disappears when identity resolution, deltas, freshness or budget selection is removed?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Implement full-refresh/fixed-rule baselines and the proposed combined asset workflow.
cases: A second reviewer checks expected asset facts without copying the new engine’s output as truth.
Reproduce metrics from frozen cases and raw results, including failed/unavailable runs.
Hold budget and case set constant across baselines/ablations; never mix synthetic and real-lab denominators silently.
consumers: C23: core asset qualification evidence before the optional relationship experiment.
C16 reviewers: optional asset-specific contribution evidence without replacing the end-to-end demo.
Faculty/team scope review: measured supported-profile benefit, limitations and negative findings.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous independently checks case expectations and experiment design; Omar reproduces the asset pipeline/consumer contract.
asset_research_plan.start: Post-first-slice: complete C17, C18, C19, C20, C21, C13 first; draft research/fixtures earlier without claiming measured completion.
